Cold holding equipment not maintained in good repair. Do not store time/temperature control for safety food in this unit until the unit is repaired.
Prep cooler observed at 48f

In-use utensil stored in standing water less than 135 degrees Fahrenheit.

cut tomatoes (48F - Cold Holding); cut lettuce (51F - Cold Holding)

Mop buckets being stored in front of hand sink next to 3 bay. Manager moved
